title: Evaluation case
description: One reproducible comparison unit: a disposable repository, a change to make, and what the rules are expected to say about it.

id.description: Lower-case, hyphenated, unique across the corpus. A malformed id is rejected rather than normalised: a corpus whose ids only sort of match is a corpus whose results cannot be looked up.

origin.description: Where the sources came from. 'synthetic' and 'bundled' are generated in this repository; 'external' names a project someone else holds a license to.

files.description: Repository-relative paths, written verbatim before the change.
